mmq.text: Takara, a Weatherlight companion, brokers a new deal in Mercadia in which the crew will repair the Weatherlight for the magistrate in exchange for freedom, and she later engineers the crew's escape.
Tahngarth glances at Takara, who is unaffected by the specter's wail, and Starke knows the voice is Takara's but the venom is Volrath's.
Takara kills her father Starke before the Kyren and reveals herself as Volrath in disguise, then betrays the group and steals the Bones of Ramos.
Takara makes off with the powerstones and, morphing into Volrath, takes Hanna and Karn captive and forces Hanna to repair the Weatherlight.
